fields.description: Bayside Marina Residences offers one- to three-bedroom homes on Sobha Siniya Island’s marina waterfront. The drawings range from compact apartments to three-bedroom duplexes, with landscaped parks and water views varying by position. The brochure identifies Tower C as the furnished collection, so furniture inclusion is checked by tower rather than assumed across the development.

overview: Three-bedroom Type C is a duplex with a maid’s room, powder room and balcony. The smaller two-bedroom Type A has a different space arrangement and cannot be compared by bedroom count alone. View diagrams are illustrative and remain unit-specific.
research.locationNote: Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. Island golf, marina and leisure facilities are wider master-community amenities; their access and opening arrangements need confirmation.
research.priceNote: The own developer page fetched on 31 October 2026 advertises AED 1,390,000 from, subject to inventory availability. This is a published guide, not a checked available unit, valuation or binding offer. Other historical launch advertisements may use a different price or unit mix.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder publishes 60% during construction and 40% handover without separately breaking out the booking deposit. That aggregate is preserved; a booking percentage is not invented. Obtain the detailed current instalment schedule.
research.handoverNote: Developer catalogue: September 2029. Property Finder instead reports March 2029; the FY 2025 developer snapshot supports only the year. Confirm the current unit contract before relying on either month.
unresolved: The official webpage FAQ calls the project “Bayside Beach Residences”, while its page title and branded marina brochure identify Bayside Marina Residences. The wording is retained as a source inconsistency, not a second project.
Current unit availability, signed payment dates, final specification and applicable service charges require developer/unit-specific confirmation.
